authority: Records source admission status only; does not settle all legal rights, download data, train weights or certify MFM capability.
failure_or_lesson: An MIT research codebase can evaluate on a CC BY-NC benchmark; the code license does not confer training rights over the benchmark. A licensed QA benchmark is also not automatically MFM formation gold.
goal: Admit only source material suitable for a distributable host-neutral MFM while preserving independent memory benchmarks.
procedure: Read upstream repository and dataset-specific rights separately from code licenses; identify the actual task labels, generated observations and participant/PII constraints; exclude noncommercial or redistribution-restricted corpora from shipped-weight training; reserve independent benchmark questions for qualification; keep supplementary preference data distinct from formation gold.
validation: Official LoCoMo license states CC BY-NC 4.0; CareCall official terms restrict commercial use and redistribution; LongMemEval-V2 official dataset card states Apache-2.0 and describes an evaluation benchmark; Community Alignment official README states CC BY 4.0 and flags PII/removal concerns. No corpus bytes imported.
